cases.sentence: ___ Лота оглянулась назад и превратилась в соляной столб.
cases.translation: Lot's wife looked back and turned into a pillar of salt.
cases.explain: Жена is the subject of the verb оглянулась, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: Lot was sitting at the gate of the city.
cases.explain: The genitive города shows possession — 'the gate of the city'.

cases.sentence: Два ангела пришли в Содом к ___.
cases.translation: Two angels came to Sodom by evening.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он приготовил для них ___, испек пресный хлеб.
cases.translation: He prepared food for them and baked unleavened bread.
cases.explain: The transitive verb приготовить takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Тогда Господь пролил ___ на Содом и Гоморру горящую серу с небес.
cases.translation: Then the Lord rained burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah from the sky.
cases.explain: The instrumental дождём expresses the substance that rained down.

cases.sentence: Беги в горы и не останавливайся нигде в ___.
cases.translation: Flee to the mountains and don't stop anywhere in the valley.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Густой дым поднимается от ___, как дым из печи.
cases.translation: Thick smoke was rising from the ground, like smoke from a furnace.
cases.explain: The preposition от governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Те двое взяли его за ___, и его жену, и двух дочерей.
cases.translation: The two men took him by the hand, and his wife, and his two daughters.
cases.explain: The preposition за (taking hold of a part of the body) governs the accusative case here.

reading.ru: Два ангела пришли в Содом к вечеру, и Лот сидел у ворот города.
reading.question: Where was Lot sitting when the two angels arrived?
options: At the gate of the city
reading.correct: At the gate of the city
reading.explain: The text says Lot sat 'у ворот города' — at the gate of the city.

reading.ru: Но он так настаивал, что они последовали за ним и вошли в дом.
reading.question: What convinced the angels to enter Lot's house?
reading.explain: The text says 'он так настаивал' — he insisted so strongly that they went in with him.

reading.ru: Но прежде чем они легли, все мужчины Содома, молодые и старые, окружили дом.
reading.question: Who surrounded Lot's house before the guests lay down?
options: All the men of Sodom, young and old
Only the elders of the city
reading.correct: All the men of Sodom, young and old
reading.explain: The text says 'все мужчины Содома, молодые и старые, окружили дом'.

reading.ru: Лот вышел к ним и запер за собой дверь.
reading.question: What did Lot do when he went out to the men?
options: He shut the door behind him
He brought his daughters out immediately
He ran away from the house
He called for the angels to fight
reading.correct: He shut the door behind him
reading.explain: The text says Lot 'запер за собой дверь' — shut the door behind himself.

reading.ru: А тех, кто были у двери дома, и молодых, и старых, они поразили слепотой, так что те не могли найти дверь.
reading.question: How did the angels stop the men outside the door?
options: They set the house on fire
reading.explain: The text says the angels 'поразили слепотой' the men at the door, so they could not find it.

reading.ru: Когда взошла заря, ангелы стали торопить Лота, говоря, «Торопись, уводи отсюда свою жену и двух дочерей, а не то ты погибнешь, когда наказание падет на город».
reading.question: What did the angels urge Lot to do at dawn?
options: Hurry and take his wife and two daughters out of the city
Stay and pray for the city
reading.correct: Hurry and take his wife and two daughters out of the city
reading.explain: The angels told Lot to hurry and take his wife and two daughters, or he would perish when the city was punished.

reading.ru: А жена Лота оглянулась назад и превратилась в соляной столб.
reading.question: What happened to Lot's wife?
options: She looked back and turned into a pillar of salt
She died of fear before reaching Zoar
She escaped safely to the mountains
reading.correct: She looked back and turned into a pillar of salt
reading.explain: The text states she looked back and became a pillar of salt.

reading.ru: Так, когда Бог уничтожил города-долины, он вспомнил Авраама и спас Лота от бедствия, которое разрушило города, в которых жил Лот.
reading.question: Why did God rescue Lot from the destruction?
options: Because Lot had built an altar
reading.explain: The text says God 'вспомнил Авраама и спас Лота' — remembered Abraham and saved Lot.

reading.ru: Лот и две его дочери покинули Циар и поселились в горах, так как он боялся оставаться в Циаре.
reading.question: Why did Lot leave Zoar to live in the mountains?
options: Because he was afraid to stay in Zoar
Because the town was destroyed too
Because his daughters wanted to travel
reading.correct: Because he was afraid to stay in Zoar
reading.explain: The text says he was afraid to remain in Zoar, so he settled in the mountains instead.

reading.ru: Так обе дочери Лоты забеременели от отца.
reading.question: What was the outcome of the daughters' plan with wine?
options: Both daughters became pregnant by their father
They found husbands in the mountains
reading.correct: Both daughters became pregnant by their father
reading.explain: The text says both of Lot's daughters became pregnant by their father.
